introduction: Explore Arcium’s fallen kingdom, understand Joji’s six-heart request and follow the separate forest, royal and dream routes.
orientation: Reach the dark trail from the nearby surface hills or jungle, then explore the forest, swamp, graveyard and undead tower. Discovery follows actual arrival; a map, view or travel message is not arrival.

Ask Joji about hi, king, kovii, granra, kelien, slican, kurlon, fragnox, lord or lords for one response family. These aliases explain his revenge request; they are not ten separate quest achievements.

Joji accepts one each of the six named hearts together for the shield Hope and then retires. The material rows show your current loose inventory. The native request does not require a personal kill, a remembered first recovery or a prior conversation; supplied exact hearts also fit.

The six hearts share a similar appearance but have different identities. They start hidden on their six carriers. Revealing an item, recovering it, receiving it from another player and completing the joint offering are separate facts.

The royal soldiers carry the skeleton key. It opens the pickproof approaches to the Room of Release, Sealed Crypt and Hidden Escape. The swamp creature carries a different key for the green gate. Current key custody, unlock, opening and successful crossing are separate.

These keys are NORENT and have a native break chance on a successful unlock. A remembered visit or accepted quest does not replace a missing key. Locked approaches and closed return sides differ under the authored resets.
The dungeon’s downward trapdoor starts hidden and closed. Search and opening admission matter on that route to the Dragons Haven; access is not a prerequisite receipt for Joji’s request.

ENTER the fixed zipline cart at the private lookout to reach the dark trail. ENTER the fluffy bed in the Room of Release reaches the Drifting Realm. LOOK reality there returns to the Room of Release; the distant cliff has a separate JUMP return. Successful travel and each destination’s discovery are separate.
Kovii also carries the green crystal skull that belongs to Qin’s separate Drifting Realm request. It is not one of Joji’s six hearts and does not complete the Arcium story.

Kurlon is listed for shield combat, but his effective lesson binding needs builder review. Paid epic learning is currently unavailable while accounting is active. Meeting him, learning and delivering his heart are separate outcomes.

Mredock’s generated world quests and drinks service are separate from Joji’s request. Use quest for your current generated task; actual target progress, payment, delivered reward and saved history need their own evidence.

Joji’s revenge does not establish that the kingdom’s disease or curse is lifted. Granra’s holiness, Kelien’s restoration, Lorik’s dragon mandate, the former slave and haunted graveyard suggest wider choices that need defined lasting outcomes.

The living forest, swamp, underwater chambers, dark tower and healing lodge use current native movement and effect rules. Dangerous or magical descriptions do not create extra quest requirements or award recovery, cure or rescue.

New journal tracking requires active READY accounting. Fresh native item resets are currently guarded during an accounting epoch. Daily renewal needs actual accountable source and giver generations; the daily policy remains disabled.

stories.title: Bring Joji the six hearts of Arcium
stories.summary: Bring one exact heart from each named lord together for Hope. Current preparation, personal source history and the accepted joint offering are separate; the reward does not certify that the kingdom’s curse is lifted.

steps.hint: The king carries it in the Sealed Crypt. The skeleton key opens the northeast approach from the royal quarters. Each heart starts hidden on its carrier. Reveal and recover the exact item under current conditions, or bring a supplied exact copy. This row shows current materials; it does not record a personal kill or first recovery.

Granra carries it in the royal Burial Ground, beyond the ordinary closed southeast fence from the graveyard. Each heart starts hidden on its carrier. Reveal and recover the exact item under current conditions, or bring a supplied exact copy. This row shows current materials; it does not record a personal kill or first recovery.

Kurlon carries it in the Hidden Escape. Its southeast approach from the royal quarters uses the skeleton key. Each heart starts hidden on its carrier. Reveal and recover the exact item under current conditions, or bring a supplied exact copy. This row shows current materials; it does not record a personal kill or first recovery.

Fragnox carries it in the Moonlit Cave beyond the Dragons Haven. The dungeon’s downward trapdoor is a separate hidden route. Each heart starts hidden on its carrier. Reveal and recover the exact item under current conditions, or bring a supplied exact copy. This row shows current materials; it does not record a personal kill or first recovery.

Kelien carries it in the Tree Trunker Lodge in the Forbidden Forest. The underground pit is a separate route. Each heart starts hidden on its carrier. Reveal and recover the exact item under current conditions, or bring a supplied exact copy. This row shows current materials; it does not record a personal kill or first recovery.

Slican carries it at the dirt path’s Sudden End near the graveyard. The pit door leads into the underwater cavern. Each heart starts hidden on its carrier. Reveal and recover the exact item under current conditions, or bring a supplied exact copy. This row shows current materials; it does not record a personal kill or first recovery.

Offer one of each of the six exact hearts together, loose in your inventory, to Joji in the dungeon. Incomplete sets stay with you under the durable offering path. The accepted receipt records the shield reward and giver retirement; possessing Hope or a heart does not create that receipt.
